messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front styling and the back view for the back styling. Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color, identity, and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands facing the camera, then turns to the side, raises a hand to the chin, and turns back to face forward.","camera":"Static low-angle full-body shot from across the road.","clothing":"Light blue cable-knit sweater, dark gray cropped trousers, light socks, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Light blonde.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a small topknot bun at the crown of the head.","identity":"A slim adult with light skin and a short, closely cropped face, standing in the center of the road.","scene":"An empty paved road under a concrete overpass, with roadwork barriers and signs on the right and trees and a fence on the left in bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair was changed from short cropped hair to a pulled-up topknot/bun at the crown, with the sides and back appearing closely cropped. The light blonde hair color, clothing, body, scene, camera, and action remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, transferring only shape and structure while preserving the original hair color, identity, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the back styling matches the reference's long hanging ponytail, since the person does not fully turn their back to the camera.
unexpected_changes: The reference's front styling, with longer hair combed upward and forward, is not clearly visible; the output mainly shows a topknot.
